result.label: A. tokenpack range-fetch one file
result.detail: fetchPackManifest reads the manifest header, then fetchPackFile issues a Range header for the target region. No pixel decode. Two HTTP calls.

result.label: B. tokenpack whole pack + decode
result.detail: fetch(packUrl).blob() then decode(blob) → DirPack → pack.extract(path). Whole pack downloaded; full pixel decode; one file extracted.

result.label: C. http single file (no pack)
result.detail: Plain fetch(fileUrl) for the target file only. Baseline for one file.

result.label: D. http all files (no pack)
result.detail: Parallel fetch(...) for every file in the pack. Baseline for "no pack at all".
